title: Design System: Trader — Statement of Account

brass.scope: Series colour, licensed only inside the never-sold replay chart, its legend swatch, and the top rule of the counterfactual card.

display.purpose: The one figure that answers the page. Weight 900, tabular, between a 4px rule above and a 2px rule below. One per sheet.

headline.purpose: Page title, set directly under the 6px ink masthead rule.

title.purpose: A subordinate figure on a ruled account line, e.g. win rate.

label.purpose: Column heads, chart titles, unit and currency notes, in reference grey. Sentence case, never uppercase tracked-out.

rules.name: masthead
rules.purpose: Opens every page, above the heading. Once per page.

rules.name: section
rules.purpose: Opens any section, chart block, verdict, or table header.

rules.name: hairline
rules.purpose: Between table rows and inside a section.

rules.name: leader
rules.purpose: The dotted leader between a label and its figure on an account line.

motion.name: drawer-in
motion.purpose: The only motion in the system: the right-hand drawer entering.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and selection wash changes on rows, buttons, chart targets.

series.name: actual
series.purpose: What you actually did. Solid 2px line.

series.name: never-sold
series.purpose: The path not taken: the holding you sold. Solid 2px brass line; the one thing the replay exists to show.

series.name: reinvested
series.purpose: Proceeds into the index. Solid 2px reference-grey line.

series.name: invested-baseline
series.purpose: Capital deployed. 1.25px dashed (4 4) reference grey at 0.7 opacity; distinguished from its solid sibling by the dash, not the hue.

components.name: Primary Action Bar
components.description: The solid black bar at the top right of the masthead row. One per page.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; background: #0b0c0c; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #0b0c0c; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #22282a; border-color: #22282a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid transparent; background: #ffdd00; color: #0b0c0c; box-shadow: 0 -2px #ffdd00, 0 4px #0b0c0c; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Squared outline button for every non-primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; background: transparent; color: #0b0c0c; border: 1px solid #0b0c0c; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f3f2f1; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid transparent; background: #ffdd00; color: #0b0c0c; box-shadow: 0 -2px #ffdd00, 0 4px #0b0c0c; }

components.name: Account Line
components.description: The system's core row: label, 2px dotted leader, tabular figure flushed right. Carries the balance and every subordinate figure.
components.html: Net result£30,087
components.css: .ds-account-line { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem; width: 100%; flex-wrap: wrap; row-gap: 0.2rem; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0b0c0c; } .ds-account-line > :last-child { margin-left: auto; } .ds-account-label { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-account-leader { flex: 1; height: 1px; border-bottom: 2px dotted #b1b4b6; transform: translateY(-0.35em); } .ds-account-figure { font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 8vw, 4rem); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1; } .ds-up { color: #00703c; } .ds-down { color: #d4351c; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-account-leader { display: none; } .ds-account-figure { width: 100%; text-align: right; } }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: The page opening: a 6px ink rule, a 900-weight heading, a standfirst, and the primary action bar at top right.
components.html:
Statement of account

Profit, loss, and what’s still open — all in account currency.
components.css: .ds-masthead { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem; border-top: 6px solid #0b0c0c; padding-top: 0.85rem; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-masthead-title { margin: 0 0 0.2rem; font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 4vw, 3.1rem); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.02; color: #0b0c0c; } .ds-masthead-lead { margin: 0; color: #505a5f; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-masthead-action { background: #0b0c0c; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #0b0c0c; border-radius: 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.88rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-masthead-action:hover { background: #22282a; border-color: #22282a; }

components.name: Ruled Position Table
components.description: The ledger: no frame, no fill. 2px ink rule under the header, 1px hairline between rows, numeric columns flushed right and tabular.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: transparent; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #0b0c0c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1; } .ds-table th { text-align: left; padding: 0.45rem 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0b0c0c; background: transparent; border-bottom: 2px solid #0b0c0c; } .ds-table td { padding: 0.45rem 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #b1b4b6; background: transparent; } .ds-table th:nth-child(n+3), .ds-table td:nth-child(n+3) { text-align: right; } .ds-table tbody tr { cursor: pointer; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background: #f3f2f1; } .ds-table .ds-row-selected td { background: #f3f2f1; box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 #0b0c0c; } .ds-table .ds-up { color: #00703c; } .ds-table .ds-down { color: #d4351c; } .ds-status-open { display: inline-block; border-radius: 0; border: 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem; background: #cce2d8; color: #005a30; } .ds-status-closed { display: inline-block; border-radius: 0; border: 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem; background: #f6d7d2; color: #942514; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The one permitted enclosure: a 2px ink stroke that says 'editable' on a sheet with no boxes.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #505a5f; } .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #0b0c0c; border: 2px solid #0b0c0c; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem; font: inherit; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #505a5f; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid transparent; background: #ffdd00; color: #0b0c0c; box-shadow: 0 -2px #ffdd00, 0 4px #0b0c0c; }

components.name: Filter Chip Row
components.description: Squared filter tabs. The selected one is inked in, never tinted.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip { background: transparent; color: #0b0c0c; border: 1px solid #0b0c0c; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #f3f2f1; } .ds-chip-active { background: #0b0c0c; color: #ffffff; border-color: #0b0c0c; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid transparent; background: #ffdd00; color: #0b0c0c; box-shadow: 0 -2px #ffdd00, 0 4px #0b0c0c; }

components.css: .ds-verdict { font-family: "Public Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid #b1b4b6; } .ds-verdict-kicker { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; color: #505a5f; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-verdict-head { border: 0; border-top: 2px solid #0b0c0c; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0.8rem 0 0.9rem; } .ds-verdict-value { font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 2.4vw, 1.5rem); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-verdict-note { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #505a5f; } .ds-verdict .ds-down { color: #d4351c; } .ds-verdict .ds-up { color: #00703c; } .ds-verdict-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem 0.9rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #505a5f; } .ds-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-key i { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; flex: none; } .ds-sw-actual { background: #0b0c0c; } .ds-sw-never { background: #b58840; } .ds-sw-reinv { background: #505a5f; }

narrative.overview:
This is a statement, not a terminal. The category ships dark, dense, multi-pane grids that make an amateur investor feel they are flying an aircraft; this world refuses all of it. It is black ink (#0b0c0c) on white paper, read at a desk under lamplight, in the register of a statutory annual statement — the lineage is the GOV.UK Design System and an HMRC self-assessment, not a broker dashboard. The user opens their own statement, reads what they actually did, and is shown what a sale cost them without being sold anything.

Nothing is enclosed. A box claims its contents are separate, and on a statement nothing is separate: every figure belongs to the same account. The system therefore has no cards, no panels, no wells, and no radius at all (--radius: 0px). Hierarchy is carried by three things only — horizontal rules of graded weight (1px hairline, 2px, 4px, 6px), type weight (400 body against 900 display), and white space. The masthead is a 6px black rule over a 900-weight heading; the net result sits alone as the largest figure on the sheet, held between a 4px rule above and a 2px rule below. Positions follow as a plain ruled table.

Colour is lawful, not decorative. Green and red appear on money and nowhere else; yellow appears only as the keyboard focus field. There is no brand accent hue: interaction is signalled by value — black bars, inked-in states, washes — never by tint. The world's stated risk is that it reads bureaucratic and cold if the type is set timidly, so the scale is deliberately confident: the masthead and the balance are set at weight 900 with tight tracking, and the sheet is generous with margin.
keyCharacteristics: Black ink on white paper; no dark mode, no tinted surfaces
No enclosure anywhere: no cards, no boxes, no radius, no shadow
Structure carried by ruled lines of graded weight and by type weight
One typeface (Public Sans) at every size, including numerals
Colour restricted by law to money (green/red) and focus (yellow)
Tabular figures, right-flushed, on every account line and table column

rules.name: The Money-Only Rule
rules.body: Green and red touch a figure only when that figure is money the user made or lost. A count, a date, a percentage of holdings, a symbol, a status word: never coloured. If you cannot say "this is a gain" or "this is a loss", it is ink.

rules.name: The Inked-In Rule
rules.body: A selected filter, an active nav item, a chosen tab is inked in — solid ink field, paper-coloured text — never tinted, never given a coloured border. Selection is a change in value, not in hue.

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: This system has no brand accent colour. --accent resolves to the ink. Any proposal for a chrome hue is out of world.

rules.name: The Series-Only Rule
rules.body: Brass is a data series colour, not an accent. It is licensed inside the replay chart — its line, its legend swatch, and the top rule of the card that states the same path — and it may never leak into chrome: no brass button, border, link, icon, badge, nav mark, or heading. If a colour is not encoding a plotted series or money, it is ink or reference grey.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Public Sans sets everything, numerals included. Do not introduce a serif for display, and never a monospaced face for figures — tabular numerals do the alignment work a mono face would otherwise be hired for.

rules.name: The Confident Scale Rule
rules.body: This world fails when the type is set timidly. The masthead and the balance are set at weight 900 with negative tracking and are the two largest things on the sheet by a wide margin. Do not split the difference with a polite 600.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every figure carries tabular numerals and flushes right — in tables, in stat blocks, and at the end of every account line. Columns of money must align on the digit.

rules.name: The Ruled Sheet Rule
rules.body: Sections are opened by a rule above them, never closed by a border around them. If you need to separate two things, add a rule and space; never add an outline.

rules.name: The Masthead Rule
rules.body: Every page opens with the 6px ink rule and the 900-weight heading beneath it. Nothing — no banner, no bar, no toolbar — sits above it.

rules.name: The No-Enclosure Rule
rules.body: No shadow, no glow, no gradient, no backdrop blur, no bordered card. If an element seems to need lifting off the page, it needs a rule above it and more space instead.

rules.name: The Wash-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover and selection are a flat grey wash (or a 6% ink fill on chart targets), optionally with an inset 4px ink bar on the leading edge of a selected row. State never changes an element's apparent height.

dos: Do open every page with the 6px ink masthead rule and a 900-weight heading directly under it.
Do state a headline figure as an account line: label, 2px dotted leader, tabular figure flushed right.
Do carry structure with graded horizontal rules — 6px masthead, 4px above the balance, 2px per section and table header, 1px hairline between rows.
Do ink in the active state: solid ink field, paper text, 600 weight.
Do give every figure tabular numerals and right alignment, on every breakpoint.
Do colour a figure green or red only when it is money made or lost.
Do give text inputs their 2px ink stroke; that stroke is what says "editable" on a sheet with no boxes.
Do set the type confidently. A timid masthead is the one documented way this world fails.
donts: Don't put anything in a card, panel, well, or bordered container. Add a rule and space instead.
Don't round a corner. Radius is 0px on every control in the system.
Don't add a shadow, glow, gradient, or backdrop blur to any surface.
Don't introduce a brand accent hue. Interaction is signalled by value, not colour.
Don't use yellow for anything but keyboard focus and text selection.
Don't colour a non-money value — counts, dates, tickers, statuses and percentages of holdings stay ink or reference grey.
Don't use a monospaced face for figures, or any second typeface at all; tabular Public Sans does that job.
Don't replace the focus field with an outline ring, a glow, or a border-colour shift.
Don't set a kicker or eyebrow above a heading. The masthead rule is the only thing that precedes a title.
Don't let brass out of the replay chart. It is a series colour there and nothing anywhere else.
Don't dark-mode this world or introduce a second surface tone; the flat wash is the only variation on paper.
